headline: Lenovo confirms Legion Go issues after gamers report bricked devices
summary: Lenovo Legion Go devices are being bricked by a bad software update. Gamers are reporting costly repair bills for their handhelds. Lenovo's stance on providing free fixes for these issues is unclear.

headline: The cat-and-mouse game over 3D-printed guns has begun
summary: A 3D-printed gun creator claims to have bypassed anti-firearm printing software. This escalates the "cat-and-mouse game" between regulators and individuals. The battle over 3D-printed "ghost guns" continues to evolve.

headline: Zillow and Redfin settle FTC antitrust case over their rental listings partnership
summary: Zillow and Redfin settled an FTC antitrust case. The case alleged a 2025 partnership violated antitrust laws. The deal involved Zillow paying Redfin for listings and Redfin agreeing not to compete.

headline: Robotaxis are real now — so is the pushback
summary: Robotaxis are expanding but face significant regulatory pushback. New York's governor withdrew a proposal for driverless taxis due to opposition. Commercial driverless service remains illegal in New York.

headline: Newegg Has the Least Overpriced 32GB of DDR5 6000MHz CL 30 Desktop Memory
summary: Newegg offers the best deal on 32GB DDR5 6000MHz CL30 RAM. This memory is ideal for AMD Ryzen-based gaming PC builds. It's highlighted as the least overpriced option currently available.

headline: Get a 1,000W 48V Adult Electric Bike With 28mph Top Speed and 80 Mile Range for Just $275 Shipped
summary: A 1,000W 48V adult electric bike is on sale for $275, shipped. It boasts a top speed of 28mph and an 80-mile range. The bike is presented as a fast and efficient way to commute, especially for students.

headline: The Witcher 3 Songs of the Past Expansion Confirmed to Include More Gwent, and Everyone Is Already Celebrating
summary: The Witcher 3's "Songs of the Past" expansion will feature more Gwent content. CD Projekt Red confirmed the addition, thrilling card game fans. Players are celebrating the return of the popular in-game card game.

headline: The FlashForge AD5X Multi-Color 3D Printer Drops to Just $203 Shipped at AliExpress
summary: The FlashForge AD5X Multi-Color 3D Printer is on sale for $203, shipped. This deal is available exclusively on AliExpress. The same printer costs $350 on Amazon, marking a significant discount.

headline: Organised crime arrests as police investigate A66 crash that killed two officers
summary: Police arrested 12 individuals in connection with an A66 crash. The investigation focuses on organised crime linked to the incident. The crash tragically resulted in seven fatalities, including two police officers.

headline: How the deadly A66 crash unfolded leaving seven dead
summary: A deadly crash on the A66 motorway resulted in seven deaths. The incident occurred early Saturday morning at 03:30 BST. Two police officers were killed when a Volkswagen Passat collided with their vehicle.

headline: Burnham vows support for Ukraine despite 'outrageous threats' from Russia
summary: Burnham pledges continued support for Ukraine. This follows "outrageous threats" issued by Russia. Moscow's warnings stem from reports of Ukraine using British drones.

headline: Beyond China's humanoid robots, a quieter machine revolution is unfolding
summary: China's factories employ over two million robots. A rapid machine revolution is quietly transforming Chinese industry. Beyond humanoid robots, industrial automation is scaling up quickly.
